text:
The Quillfeather Archive in Harrowmere was founded by Emeric Volkov, according to the "Volkov Deed of Establishment," the document on which the institution's origins rest. The deed is held in the Archive's vault.

The Archive's founding charter was signed on 14 March 1927. Dr. Ilsabet Marrowgate, chief archivist of the Quillfeather Archive, confirmed the founding account after the deed was consulted.

The original collection held 3,412 catalogued manuscripts at opening, the deed records. That inventory has served as the baseline for the Archive's cataloguing since.

Dr. Marrowgate said the deed names Mr. Volkov as the sole founder and establishes the Archive as a permanent repository. The Continental Record reviewed the account as set out in the deed and in the chief archivist's confirmation. No competing claim to the Archive's founding is recorded in either source.
